svg.aria-label: Prefetchers, L1D ways and power, dTLB extras
svg.text: Prefetchers, L1D ways and power, dTLB extras

Where the prefetchers train and what holds them back; how a line gets its L1D way and how the SRAM sleeps; what a TLB entry carries and how it is invalidated. Dashed outlines are inferred, dotted are speculative.
Prefetch: trained on virtual addresses at the LSU, throttled by the L2
L1D: a hashed way, no way mispredict, sleeping sub arrays, and the coherence ceiling
dTLB: page size in the entry, invalidation by the cheaper route
a chase that crosses pages keeps its L1 latency
speculative: the way is fixed by a hash of page bits,
2^k + 64 B chains: one way per set
latency, fixed page vs 8 random pages
one TLB entry (field widths are illustrative)
presence vector, 5 page sizes per context
the M1 shows only 16 KiB pages
